The offline RL result is not fully convincing. The improvement over Meta-World dense rewards is small with overlapping confidence intervals, GVL is omitted, task-wise results and success rates are missing, and the construction of the offline dataset/reward relabeling pipeline is underspecified.

Reproducibility and clarity have notable gaps. There are apparent inconsistencies in reported sampling hyperparameters between the main text and appendix, unclear learning-rate wording in Appendix D.3, limited split/curation details, no code or model release information, and no uncertainty estimates for the main real-world VOC table.

The novelty is moderate: the main technical ingredients are a fairly direct application of meta-learned test-time training to CLIP features plus a simple diversity sampling heuristic. The paper’s impact therefore depends heavily on empirical strength, but the current evidence has substantial validity concerns.
